responsibility: This header declares the entry point for parser pass 1 in the mc front end. It exports the CompilationUnit routine that parses a source module sufficiently to establish initial syntax and declaration structure for subsequent passes.
same_name_distinction: This .h file only declares the mcp1_CompilationUnit entry used to invoke parser pass 1. Unlike the same-stem .cc file, it does not contain the generated grammar, recovery sets, or first-pass parsing and declaration-building actions.
